name: Hotel Sattlerwirt
beschreibung: The Hotel Sattlerwirt is located in Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland, near the town of Kufstein and at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser. The quiet, rural atmosphere of the family-run house shapes guests' stay. The hotel's own wellness area includes an indoor pool, various saunas and relaxation rooms. Half board is usually served as a multi-course menu with regional and seasonal Tiroler specialties. The location is ideal for hikes and bike tours in the Kaisergebirge and along the Inn. In winter, the ski areas of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental as well as the nearby Kaiserbahn are quickly reachable. The rooms are kept in a traditional country-house style and often have a balcony or terrace.
